aboutPage.title: Dedicated Craftsmanship & Quality in Jeddah
aboutPage.subtitle: We operate in the heart of Jeddah as a trusted destination for car owners seeking dealership-level finishes at sensible, honest prices.
aboutPage.storyP1: Markaz Jadda was established to deliver genuine auto body repair, oven-baked spray painting, and mechanical maintenance. Through years of serving the Jeddah community, we have earned customer trust through honesty, punctual turnaround, and meticulous craftsmanship.
